name: olivertwins-RE
install:
set -euo pipefail
if [ -f pds6502.py ]; then
  root=.
elif [ -f pds6502/pds6502.py ]; then
  root=pds6502
elif [ -f repos/pds6502/pds6502.py ]; then
  root=repos/pds6502
else
  echo "pds6502.py not found" >&2
  exit 1
fi
python3 -m py_compile "$root/pds6502.py" "$root/pds_extract.py" "$root/tests/smoke_test.py"
python3 "$root/tests/smoke_test.py"
if [ -d repos ]; then
  editor_root=repos
else
  editor_root=..
fi
for editor in magicianedit robinedit; do
  dir="$editor_root/$editor"
  if [ -f "$dir/package-lock.json" ]; then
    npm ci --prefix "$dir"
  fi
done
